title: KITE: population experiments on Jev with sparse flagship calibration (code, evaluation records and forecast ledger)
description: Code, frozen criteria, evaluation records and aggregate results for the preprint 'KITE: Scaling Jev Population Experiments with Sparse Flagship Calibration' (arXiv:2609.27535), and the protocol of its prospective forecast ledger: forecasts of experiments whose results are not yet public are sealed with salted SHA-256 digests and revealed after the results are out, under scoring rules fixed before any forecast.
